title: rosa stylosa subsp. rusticana
intro: Rosa stylosa subsp. rusticana, commonly known as the wild rose, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, fever, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects. The therapeutic actions of Rosa stylosa subsp. rusticana include soothing and calming effects, making it useful for treating anxiety and stress, and its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, contribute to its medicinal properties. Additionally, the plant's antioxidant and antimicrobial properties make it a valuable resource for promoting overall well-being and preventing infections.
